title: Approval card: nothing happens until I press
evidence: It works, its look is not the oracle's yet. useConversation.ts takes Barkpark's approval_requested (plan mode asks for the plan, then each step) and Transcript.tsx shows a plain card: what the bot asks, the plan, command or file text, Deny and Allow; nothing is sent until a press (chat/api.ts answerApproval). scripts/behaviour.mjs: 4 rules against the stand-in (card and no answer; Allow once; the card goes when confirmed; Deny). Live: npm run turn:live -- --approve (2026-11-13: 2 cards allowed, the file was in the bot's folder; parity/live/approve.json). Missing: the oracle's approval card has never been captured (it needs a send that makes the oracle ask), so the look, the wording and where the card sits are unread. A reload in the middle of an ask brings the card back from Barkpark's stored row, only while the bot's state is blocked (behaviour rule 'an ask after a reload'). Oracle 1.0.3, 2026-11-14 (two sends, recipes ask-leave and ask-leave-2): no card. It made and deleted a file in its home folder without asking; its Permissions settings name Always Ask, Allow without Asking and Auto-Review, so a card needs a setting changed, which is the owner's to do (fixtures/oracle-1.0.3).
